newsitem.title: UK: TREG calls on KEPIT for plan details.
newsitem.headline: TREG calls on KEPIT for plan details.

text.p: TR European Growth Trust (TREG) called on the board of Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc (KEPIT) to give investors a detailed estimate of the value of its unitisation proposals.
In a statement, TREG said it felt investors needed such an estimate "in order to make an informed assessment" of the merits of those plans compared with TREG's hostile bid.
Under the bid for KEPIT, TREG is offering 103.1 pence for shares and warrants if holders opt for cash, or the equivalent of 107.6 pence if they choose to take TR European shares.
But KEPIT is challenging the deal TR European can get for the shares and points out that it can offer an extra 10 million stg in cost savings.
It has also called on TR European to reveal the costs of the sale, which could be the biggest ever programme trade in European equities if the 500 million stg portfolio is liquidated.

TR European says that KEPIT has not told shareholders what they will get and is offering them the choice of cash or two European investment vehicles whose performance is markedly inferior to that of TR European.
